workflows.name: office-intro-sequence
workflows.description: Tag a contact 'intro' to send the intro and, without a reply, one follow-up after 5 business days. Any reply stops it.

workflows.name: rate-query-handover
workflows.description: When a reply asks for rates or services: extract the shipment, tell the office owner, tag the contact and hand a lead to pricing (high priority from 5 containers).

sample_scripts.name: USA-Canada air to country
sample_scripts.subject: Air freight from the USA or Canada {to_country}
sample_scripts.body:
Hi {first_name|there},

Hope all is well.

Just reaching out to see if you have any upcoming air freight enquiries from the USA or Canada {to_country}.

With our strong airline partnerships and sharp rates, we'd be pleased to provide our best quote for any opportunities you can share to win business.

{banner}

We look forward to quoting your next shipment.

Best regards,

{signature}

You're receiving this email as a fellow {network|freight network} member.

Prefer not to receive these emails? {unsubscribe_link|Unsubscribe here}.
